lessons: Premise is false: the ticket needs `run` to execute in tests/integration/test_stages_helpers_repo.py with a FakeFileSystem and no file writes. clutch/stages.py writes through ctx.fs but reads many paths straight from disk, and clutch/stages.py is outside the fence.

Examples in clutch/stages.py: line 775 reads the ticket with `(ctx.repo / ticket_path(ticket.stem)).read_text()`, line 1156 reads run.md, lines 1705/1715 read worktree bytes and line 1994 reads the ticket for review. Files the `repo` fixture or `author` put in FakeFileSystem are missing on disk for

The integration I/O guard (tests/integration/conftest.py `blocked_operation`) blocks any open-for-write, tmp_path included. So in an integration test the `repo` fixture cannot put real files where stages.py reads them from disk. Acceptance criteria 1 and the `run` integration test cannot both be

Refile: first, a ticket that sends every stages.py read through ctx.fs (fs.read_bytes / an exists check). Then this ticket depends on it. Or move the `run` behavior test into REAL_IO_TESTS / tests/unit and use a real tmp_path repo, with the owner's agreement.

Also check GitFake: it returns canned overrides and keeps no repository state (tests/git_fake.py). The ticket must name the overrides `run` needs (rev_parse, diff_names, diff, commit) so stages see the commits made by `agent` and `author`.
